integrity: The counterexample is an exact two-dimensional Parseval construction. The failed projection identity is checked algebraically, and the general projection-product equivalence is proved directly. Earlier and later intersection theorems with explicit commutation hypotheses were compared as prior context.
scientific_limitations: The finding refutes the unrestricted closed-subspace inheritance statement in the specialization \(K=T=U=I\) and proves a commutation-based repair for ordinary fusion-frame weaving. It does not claim that commutation is necessary for every individual restricted family, nor that it alone repairs the full controlled setting.
title: A two-dimensional obstruction to unrestricted subspace intersection of woven controlled \(K\)-\(g\)-fusion frames
